title: Feynman diagrams for the electron's magnetic moment at each order of QED
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale. The number of vertex diagrams at each order of the calculation of the electron's anomalous magnetic moment: 1 at one loop (Schwinger, 1948), 7 at two loops, 72 at three, 891 at four and 12,672 at five. Data: Aoyama, Kinoshita and Nio (2019).
heading: VERTEX DIAGRAMS · LOG SCALE
